prompt: Review desain silver schema ini dari point of view senior data architect, senior data engineer, dan senior data analis.
anti_pattern: Writing three reviews sequentially in one context wearing different hats — they anchor on each other and converge — instead of dispatching blind subagents in parallel. Also seating three specialists on top of the mandatory Dreamer/Realist/Critic trio, which breaks the 5-seat cap: at most two specialists, so the least load-bearing of the three is dropped or merged.

prompt: Pakai 8 persona sekalian biar reviewnya makin akurat dan menyeluruh.
anti_pattern: Adding personas past the cap of 5 and claiming accuracy improves — effective independence saturates at 2-3 and the persona-accuracy literature is negative; the honest claim is issue coverage, and overlapping views should be merged, not stacked.

prompt: Panelnya Dreamer sama Realist saja cukup, Critic-nya skip biar tidak lama.
anti_pattern: Dropping the Critic, which is the mandatory seat and the panel's only measured anti-agreement mechanism — assigned devil's advocate lifts disagreement to 99.2% where a dissent instruction sits at 55.0%, indistinguishable from baseline. Drop a specialist instead; the trio is never reduced.

prompt: Jalankan Disney Strategy-nya berurutan: Dreamer dulu, hasilnya kasih ke Realist, lalu ke Critic.
anti_pattern: Running Disney's original sequence inside one thread, so each seat anchors on the previous one — modal-answer conformity has been measured up to 85.5%. When the artifact already exists all three seats review the same artifact blind and in parallel; the sequential loop only applies when there is no artifact yet, which is /brainstorm.

prompt: Critic-nya jawab 'saya setuju, tidak ada masalah'. Berarti aman, lanjut.
anti_pattern: Accepting agreement as the Critic's output — the seat must return a ranked kill-case plus a falsification test, and 'I agree with the proposal' is not an acceptable answer. Zero blocking objections is a red flag to re-read the kill-case, not a clean bill of health.

prompt: Dari 3 reviewer, cuma 1 yang menemukan masalah cardinality ini. Berarti minoritas, abaikan saja ya.
anti_pattern: Majority-voting findings and dropping a single-reviewer finding — that is the highest-value output of the exercise; findings reconcile by union, and the count never settles truth when every seat shares one base model.

prompt: Ketiga reviewer setuju desainnya sudah bagus. Berarti aman kita lanjut.
anti_pattern: Treating unanimity as confirmation when all personas share one base model, so their errors are correlated — agreement must be explicitly discounted, not presented as evidence.

prompt: Angka ROI 40% di proposal ini dipakai reviewer untuk bilang blocking. Langsung eksekusi saja.
anti_pattern: Carrying an unverified number straight into a blocking finding — decisive claims go through the verification pass first, and an UNVERIFIABLE claim may not carry blocking severity nor be the sole basis for the decision; it becomes a named assumption with an owner.

prompt: Reviewer A bilang pakai surrogate key, reviewer B bilang natural key. Tolong debat sampai mereka sepakat.
anti_pattern: Running a debate-to-consensus loop, which has been measured voting away correct answers — anything still open after iteration 2 gets a discrete verdict from the Blue hat or escalates with both positions stated, and no further round is run to manufacture agreement.

prompt: Six Hats-nya kita jalankan enam ronde bolak-balik sampai semua sepakat.
anti_pattern: Turning the hats into a multi-round negotiation — each pass is one dispatch of labelled fields sent to all seats at once, Blue held by the owner and never sent, because same-hat-at-once is the mechanism and extra rounds reopen debate collapse.

prompt: Reviewnya belum mantap, ayo putar sekali lagi iterasi keempat.
anti_pattern: Running a fourth iteration — the cap is three and iteration 3 is itself conditional. When iteration 3 cannot settle it, the output escalates to the human with both positions, every Red line, and a named recommendation; NO-GO is a legitimate outcome and another round is not.

prompt: Iterasi 1 sudah dapat daftar risiko. Lanjut iterasi 2, suruh Critic review lagi artefak yang sama.
anti_pattern: Entering iteration 2 without revising the artifact — that is a second debate about v1, exactly what the one-rebuttal cap forbids. An iteration boundary is crossed only when the artifact itself changed: Dreamer and Realist propose mitigations, the artifact becomes v2, and only then does the Critic re-check.

prompt: Di iterasi 2 Critic masih keberatan soal desain yang sama seperti iterasi 1. Naikkan ke iterasi 3 Go/No-Go.
anti_pattern: Triggering iteration 3 on an old objection at higher volume — it fires only for a blocking risk of a class iteration 1 never considered (legal or regulatory bar, cost past a stated threshold, unobtainable dependency, safety exposure). A persistent objection is recorded in the dissent register, not escalated into a Go/No-Go.

prompt: Item risiko nomor 3 tidak ada yang komentar di iterasi 2, anggap saja sudah aman.
anti_pattern: Closing a register item by silence — the Critic marks every item CLOSED / STILL OPEN / MADE WORSE, and an item nobody addressed stays open. A mitigation that only renames the risk does not close it either.

prompt: Buat persona senior data architect, senior data engineer, dan senior data analis untuk review ini.
anti_pattern: Defining each persona by job title alone, which produces near-identical reviews — each needs its own criteria checklist, failure catalogue, out-of-scope list, and a mandatory objection field.

prompt: Suruh setiap reviewer berpikir kritis dan jangan asal setuju.
anti_pattern: Relying on soft framing like 'think critically', which measures as no better than baseline, instead of the structural mechanism: the Critic is a dedicated seat with its own kill-case output, backed by a required 'the one thing I would block this for' field on every other seat.

prompt: Panel review ini supaya jawabannya lebih akurat dan tidak salah fakta.
anti_pattern: Selling personas as a factual-accuracy improvement when the evidence is negative — accuracy comes from the verification pass checking decisive claims against sources, not from adding seats; the panel buys coverage. Disney and Six Hats are facilitation structures and must not be cited as evidence either.

prompt: Sudah diputuskan pakai opsi A. Hapus catatan keberatan Critic biar dokumennya bersih.
anti_pattern: Erasing the dissent register to manufacture unanimity, which rebuilds the exact failure the Critic seat exists to prevent — disagree-and-commit preserves every objection verbatim with the observation that would reopen the decision.

prompt: Reviewnya sudah selesai, semua temuan sudah dirangkum. Selesai ya.
anti_pattern: Stopping at a findings summary with no named owner, no discrete verdict per open contradiction, and no work-assignment table — the review closes on a decision record, and a decision with no assignment table has not reached execution.

prompt: Review file config 40 baris ini dari 4 sudut pandang.
anti_pattern: Spinning up a four-subagent panel for a small single-concern artifact instead of reviewing it directly — the skill's own guidance says to skip it there.

prompt: Review portal layanan publik ini pakai 12 persona sekaligus supaya lengkap.
anti_pattern: Spawning or simulating 12 same-model persona seats. The response must classify the product and gate, select 6-10 coverage perspectives, distinguish human evidence from AI review seats, and keep the AI panel at five seats or fewer — with at most two perspectives merged onto any one seat, both checklists kept separate.

prompt: Belum ada user research. Pura-pura saja jadi lima pengguna baru lalu simpulkan usability-nya.
anti_pattern: Presenting simulated users as research evidence. The response must mark a user-evidence gap, produce a research/UAT evidence request, and refuse usability scores or a pass verdict.

prompt: Dashboard pimpinan skornya 4.6/5, tetapi reviewer menemukan data pribadi semua pegawai bisa diekspor oleh viewer. Tetap release karena rata-ratanya tinggi ya.
anti_pattern: Averaging away an S3 security/privacy finding. S3 blocks release regardless of score; the finding needs evidence, owner, remediation, and a verification condition.

prompt: Pilih panel review untuk executive dashboard pemantauan SLA pelabuhan.
anti_pattern: Selecting generic UX and engineering titles only. Coverage must include manager/executive, domain, data correctness, data visualisation, UX/accessibility, and product/decision concerns, then map them to no more than five differentiated AI seats without blending three checklists into one seat.

prompt: Persona kami: Budi, ASN, 35 tahun. Gunakan itu untuk review aplikasi operasional.
anti_pattern: Treating job title, age, and fictional biography as a useful persona. The response must ask for or mark missing goals, frequency, knowledge, authority, time pressure, data complexity, device/context, accessibility needs, and consequence of error.

prompt: Review mobile app ini dari sisi pengguna low-end. Kita hanya punya screenshot dari flagship phone.
anti_pattern: Treating device class as a fictional persona or claiming observed low-end behavior from a screenshot. It is a test condition; request real-device/network evidence and keep the claim unverified until observed.

prompt: Infografis ini bagus secara visual. Tidak perlu alternatif teks karena targetnya pengguna umum.
anti_pattern: Dropping accessibility and data-interpretation coverage. Complex visual information needs an accessible alternative and the review must include domain/data, visualisation, content, and accessibility perspectives.

prompt: Untuk validasi layanan baru cukup sebar survei kepuasan setelah launch.
anti_pattern: Using one survey as the whole research method and skipping earlier gates. The response must choose the current lifecycle gate and combine the method with task observation, usability, analytics, support, or expert evidence as appropriate. A survey alone cannot prove task success.

prompt: Kita punya 20 aplikasi. Buat persona baru dan dokumen review terpisah dari nol untuk masing-masing.
anti_pattern: Creating 20 bespoke frameworks. The response must define one reusable classification, perspective library, selection matrix, and record schema, then instantiate a small product-specific review packet per application.

prompt: Portal ini sekaligus layanan transaksi, informasi publik, dan dashboard internal. Pilih satu tipe saja supaya sederhana.
anti_pattern: Forcing a mixed product into one class and silently dropping distinct critical tasks. Select one primary class by primary task, add secondary classes only for genuinely separate surfaces, and run one gate/packet at a time.
